job.title: Performance Marketeer - Specialist Levensverzekeringen @ Ethias (VLG, BE)
job.description:
**Kom bij Ethias werken als** 
***Performance Marketeer - Specialist Levensverzekeringen***
===========================================================================================

* Limburg - Liège-Hasselt
* Contract onbepaalde duur

### **Wij bieden jou**

* Veel variatie
* Breed voordelenpakket
* Resultaatsgedreven team

### **Jij biedt**

* Analytische ingesteldheid
* Communicatievaardigheden
* Specifieke vakkennis

### **Jij kiest voor Ethias, voor**

* De interesse in verzekeringen
* De uitdagingen en interessante projecten
* De mogelijkheid tot directe impact

### **Een blik op jouw volgende** ***uitdaging*****…**

Als **Performance Marketeer Specialist Levensverzekeringen** zet je levensverzekeringen, pensioenopbouw en langetermijnoplossingen om in **sterke campagnes die klanten bereiken én resultaat opleveren**. Je combineert je expertise in Life met performance marketing en vertaalt complexe financiële producten naar heldere proposities en relevante klantvoordelen.

Je volgt de volledige campagnefunnel op, van doelgroep en activatie tot conversie en optimalisatie. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met **Product, Sales, CRM, Content, UX, Analytics en Legal/Compliance** en gebruik je data en inzichten om campagnes continu sterker te maken.

**Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:**

* Je ontwikkelt doelgroepgerichte campagneplannen voor onze Levensverzekeringen, rekening houdend met klantbehoeften, distributiestrategie en commerciële doelstellingen.
* Je vertaalt productkenmerken naar duidelijke USP’s, boodschappen en call-to-actions die begrijpelijk, relevant en compliant zijn.
* Je plant en activeert campagnes via online media, offline media, CRM en eigen kanalen.
* Je beheert de campagnefunnel van reach tot lead, van offertes tot afspraken maken.
* Je stelt samen met analytics team een meetplan en dashboarding op en bewaakt KPI’s, attributie, datakwaliteit en tagging.
* Je optimaliseert doelgroepen, media, landingspagina’s, formulieren en opvolgflows.
* Je beheert budgetten, forecasts en relaties met creatieve en/of performance bureaus.
* Je organiseert afstemming met Product & Sales zodat leads tijdig en passend worden opgevolgd.
* Je bewaakt de correcte toepassing van merk-, privacy- en compliancevereisten in elke campagne-uiting.
* Je bouwt learnings op per doelgroep, product, kanaal en vertaalt ze naar een geoptimaliseerd plan voor het volgende jaar.

### **Welke vaardigheden en** ***talenten*** **breng jij mee naar Ethias?**

* Je hebt **minstens 4 à 5 jaar relevante ervaring** in marketing en go-to-marketstrategie binnen levensverzekeringen.

* Je kent **levensverzekeringen, pensioenopbouw en beleggingsoplossingen** en hebt een goede kennis van de Belgische fiscaliteit, relevante regelgeving en de behoeften van **particuliere en professionele klanten**.

* Je maakt complexe financiële materie toegankelijk en vertaalt ze naar **heldere klantvoordelen, relevante boodschappen en sterke campagnes**.

* Je bent vertrouwd met **SEO, SEA, GEO, contentstrategie, e-mail/CRM en CRO** en blijft graag bijleren over nieuwe digitale ontwikkelingen en **AI**.

* Je combineert **analytisch inzicht met een commerciële en resultaatgerichte** mindset. Je houdt de klant voor ogen, zoekt oplossingen en voelt je thuis in een veranderende omgeving.

* Je communiceert helder, neemt verantwoordelijkheid, **stelt de juiste prioriteiten en weet verschillende stakeholders en expertises samen te brengen**.

* Je communiceert professioneel in het **Nederlands en Frans**.

### **Tal van** ***voordelen*** **die wij jou graag bieden…**

* **Een gezonde balans**

Bij Ethias kan je voluit gaan, op én naast het werk. Je krijgt alles wat je nodig hebt om je job goed te doen, zonder in te boeten op vrije tijd of gezin.
  
**• Jobzekerheid**
  
Al meer dan een eeuw staan we garant voor stabiliteit en zekerheid. Bij ons krijg je wat je verdient en dat is veel!
  
**• Groeikansen**
  
Opleidingen, workshops en netwerkmomenten geven je alle ruimte om te groeien en je plek te vinden.
  
**• Een fijne werkplek**
  
We creëren een positieve sfeer: samen sporten, lunchen, activiteiten organiseren én genieten van afterworks.
  
**• Thuiswerk**
  
Als innovatieve en moderne werkgever maken wij thuiswerk met plezier mogelijk. Je wordt minstens twee dagen op kantoor verwacht, met één vaste teamdag per week. Gezellig, toch?

*Onze onderneming hecht veel belang aan diversiteit. Daarom waarderen wij ieders competenties ongeacht achtergrond of afkomst.*

job.title: VP of Marketing @ Introw (Ghent, Flemish Region, Belgium)
job.description:
**VP of Marketing**

Introw is the #1 AI-native partner management platform. We are growing 5x year over year, signing multi-year enterprise contracts with some of the biggest logos in B2B SaaS, like Adyen, Factorial & Huntress. We raised $3M led by Visionaries VC, we serve hundreds of companies worldwide, and we hold a 4.9/5 rating across 100s of reviews.

We run inside HubSpot and Salesforce, so partner teams manage their whole program without leaving the CRM, and their partners work where they already are: Slack, Teams, email, and AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT. Globally leading companies run partnerships, their best-performing channel, on Introw.

Our mission is simple: become the #1 PRM in the world. Not one of the options, the category leader. The name every partner leader knows, recommends, and wants to work with. Legacy partner tools were built for the vendor, not the partner, so partners never logged in and programs stalled. We win on the opposite bet: people actually adopt Introw. Now we want a VP of Marketing to build the marketing engine that makes the whole world know Introw.

This is not a “manage the agencies and report on MQLs” role, and it is not a role where you inherit a finished machine. You will build the brand, the engine, and the team that make Introw the category leader, and you will be hands-on in building every one of them.

If you love hypergrowth, building things from the ground up and taking a category leader global, keep on reading!

**Tasks**

As our VP of Marketing, you take what already works and make it the engine that makes Introw the name in partnerships:

* Sharpen the marketing strategy and plan to make Introw the global category leader in partner management, and turn it into work that ships every week.
* Take our brand from known to unmissable, until every partner leader knows us, and talks about us.
* Optimise our pipeline engine so it becomes predictable, and measure marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline straight from the CRM, not from vanity dashboards.
* Raise the bar of the existing marketing team across demand generation, events, paid, SEO and AI search, product marketing, brand, and community, and expand it with the right hires.
* Upgrade the systems, playbooks, and processes so the team scales without slowing down.
* Sharpen our positioning and category story, and keep it consistent across the website, sales, product, and socials.
* Scale our US go-to-market: more than half of our customers are there, and we are opening an office in NYC soon.
* Track what works, kill what doesn’t, and double down on what grows.
* Work shoulder to shoulder with the founders, sales, partnerships, product, and customer success, and align on targets, ICP, and handoffs.

**Requirements**

You’re an A-player. You want your fingerprints on a category-defining company, and a mediocre bar bores you. The following should be how your friends describe you:

* A builder and an optimizer. You have taken a marketing function that already worked, made it twice as good, and built what was still missing.
* A proven marketing leader. Around 10 years in B2B SaaS marketing, with several years leading a team and owning a pipeline number. We care about the bar you hold more than years on paper.
* A hypergrowth veteran. You have scaled marketing through several stages of hypergrowth, and you know which playbook breaks at each one.
* A brand builder. You have made a company the name its market knows, not just another logo on a comparison page.
* Experienced in marketing a product-led or AI-native product.
* Hands-on. You still write the page, brief the campaign, or fix the dashboard yourself, and you are proud of it.
* Revenue-minded. You think in pipeline, win rates, and payback, not in likes and impressions.
* A storyteller. You turn a broad product into a clear narrative, tuned for each audience.
* A coach. You raise the bar of the team you join, hire well as it grows, and give people real ownership.
* Analytical. You know your numbers and let the data tell you what to do next.
* Comfortable with ambiguity. You make the call, move fast, and adjust.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

* A strong network in the partnerships, channel, or B2B SaaS space.
* Familiarity with partnerships, channel sales, or CRMs like HubSpot or Salesforce.

**Benefits**

How we work: we are a senior team that plays to win and hires A-players who want real ownership.

* **You own your area.**
  High trust, high autonomy, no hand-holding.
* **Craft is the point.**
  We sweat the details and hold a high bar.
* **We move fast.**
  Decisions in hours, not weeks.
* **We are ambitious.**
  We are here to win the category globally, growing 4 to 5x a year.

What you get:

* A Macbook and iPhone, fully set up for you.
* Fully paid phone subscription.
* Healthcare plan.
* Mobility budget.
* Meal vouchers.
* Introw merch.
* Regular team drinks and events, plus global travel to industry events.
* A real seat at a fast growing, well-funded, globally winning company where your work ships and gets seen.
* Optional: ESOP Equity

Ready to make Introw the #1 PRM in the world? If you want to own the brand, the number, and the team at a category leader, we want to meet you.

What to expect: a quick intro call, a deep dive on your past work, a short case where you build a plan for one of our real growth challenges, and time with the founders and the team.

job.description:
### **À propos de nous**

Créé en 1991, le SIF est une organisation non gouvernementale (ONG) internationale de secours d'urgence et de développement. Le SIF agit dans une stricte neutralité, sans distinction d’origine, de genre ni de religion et se consacre à atténuer les souffrances des populations les plus démunies dans le monde.

### **Mission**

Au sein de la Direction Communication et développement, vous êtes le garant de la croissance des ressources et du retour sur investissement (ROI) de l'organisation. Votre mission est de piloter la transformation du modèle de collecte en fusionnant les leviers digitaux et offline.

Vos principales missions seront les suivantes (liste non exhaustive et évolutive) :

* Définir et suivre les KPI de collecte sur l'ensemble des canaux. Arbitrer les investissements en fonction de la rentabilité et de la Lifetime Value (LTV) des donateurs ;
* Encadrer et monter en compétences une équipe pluridisciplinaire structurée (environ 10 collaborateurs) autour de deux piliers : fundraising & partenariats et pôle développement marketing ;
* Piloter la conception et le déploiement des temps forts (Ramadan, urgences, fin d'année) et des campagnes en fil rouge, en garantissant une expérience donateur fluide entre le papier, le terrain et le numérique ;
* Déployer des solutions d'IA (générative pour les contenus, prédictive pour le churn) et d'automatisation (marketing automation, workflows internes) pour gagner en productivité et en personnalisation ;
* Impulser une vision data-centric qui transforme la donnée brute en insights actionnables (tableaux de bord, tests A/B, optimisation du taux de conversion - CRO).

### **Profil**

* Diplôme requis : Bac+5 type École de Commerce ou Master Marketing/Data.
* 5 à 10 ans d'expérience avec un parcours "terrain" ou technique marqué (ancien responsable digital ou responsable marketing direct ayant évolué vers le 360°).
* Expertise démontrée dans la gestion de budgets d’acquisition importants et dans le pilotage d'équipes transverses.
* Curiosité pour les nouvelles technologies et volonté de tester de nouveaux modèles.
* Goût pour la performance et l'optimisation des coûts d'acquisition.
* Intérêt pour le secteur humanitaire et/ou associatif.

**Conditions**
==============

* CDI, temps plein.
* Poste à pourvoir immédiatement.
* Statut cadre, forfait jours.
* 15 jours de récupération dans le cadre du forfait jours.
* Titres restaurant / Complémentaire santé et prévoyance compétitive / Remboursement à 75% de l'abonnement des transports en commun (jusqu'au 31/12/2026).
* Déplacements ponctuels en IDF voire au niveau national.
* Possibilité de télétravail selon l’accord en vigueur (2 jours par semaine).

**Une politique RH engagée.**  
  
Le SIF considère que la diversité est une richesse. Nous étudions donc toutes les candidatures dans la mesure où elles présentent les compétences requises pour le poste à pourvoir.  
  
En tant qu'ONG humanitaire, le SIF s'engage à respecter le principe humanitaire du "Do no harm" et veille à ce que la sécurité de nos bénéficiaires (incluant les enfants), salariés, bénévoles, partenaires et prestataires soit une considération primordiale dans toutes ses activités.  
  
Le SIF pratique la tolérance zéro envers tout type de fraude, corruption, harcèlement moral/sexuel, abus ou violence de quelque nature que ce soit, et, plus généralement, toute infraction à la législation, à la réglementation, à la Politique de Sauvegarde de l'Enfance (PSE) ou au code de conduite établi en interne, au siège et sur les missions.  
  
Conformément à ces principes, ce poste est soumis à une vérification du casier judiciaire ainsi qu'à la prise de références professionnelles.  
  
Notre charte est un véritable engagement : nous mobilisons l'ensemble de notre personnel dans la promotion, la diffusion et le respect des principes édictés.  
  
Ensemble, relevons le défi pour une solidarité qui transcende les différences.

job.title: Performance Marketing & SEO Lead @ Marie-Stella-Maris (B Corp) (Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands)
job.description:
Growing an e-commerce business takes more than launching campaigns. It means making smart use of marketing investment, spotting opportunities in the data and turning them into improvements across paid media, affiliate marketing and SEO.
  
  
We’re looking for a
**Performance Marketing & SEO Lead**
who enjoys combining analysis with hands-on execution. You’ll coordinate campaigns with our agencies and internal teams, help improve our organic search performance and contribute directly to online revenue and customer growth.
  
  
**About Marie-Stella-Maris**
Marie-Stella-Maris is a renowned lifestyle and beauty brand where design, conscious living and social impact come together. Founded in Amsterdam, we create elevated home and body care essentials that enhance everyday routines while contributing to a greater purpose. Through our products and initiatives, we contribute to clean drinking water projects worldwide.
  
  
Driven by creativity, social responsibility and an entrepreneurial spirit, Marie-Stella-Maris moves with intention, refined in execution and committed to making a positive impact through everything we create.
  
  
**The Position**
We are looking for an analytical and commercially driven Performance Marketing & SEO Lead to help grow our e-commerce business through paid media, affiliate marketing, and organic search. Reporting to the E-commerce Director, you will work together to define the annual paid media and affiliate roadmap, objectives, and priorities. Your focus will be on translating these priorities into effective campaigns, coordinating execution with our external agencies, and identifying opportunities to improve performance.
  
  
You will also take ownership of driving SEO improvements, using our internal SEO platform, BrightEdge, to identify opportunities and working closely with the E-commerce Lead to implement improvements on the website.
  
  
This role combines performance analysis, campaign coordination, and hands-on activitirs, with a direct contribution to online revenue and customer acquisition.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
*Paid Media Performance & Execution*

* Work with the E-commerce Director to define the annual paid media roadmap, channel priorities, budgets, and performance objectives.
* Collaborate with our external paid media agency to deliver agreed KPIs across Google Ads, Meta, YouTube, display, TikTok, Pinterest, and other relevant channels.
* Coordinate campaign delivery, including agency briefings, asset requirements, approvals, launches, and promotional updates.
* Collaborate with Marketing and Design to create effective, on-brand campaign assets tailored to paid media channels and affiliate partners.
* Monitor spend and performance against targets, including ROAS, customer acquisition cost, conversion rate, and revenue.
* Identify opportunities to improve results through audience targeting, creative testing, budget allocation, and campaign optimization.
* Ensure campaign messaging, product availability, tracking, and landing pages are aligned and ready before launch.

*Affiliate Marketing*

* Coordinate affiliate campaigns, promotions, product launches, and seasonal activities.
* Ensure the agency and affiliate partners receive timely briefs, assets, product information, and promotional updates.
* Monitor affiliate performance, commissions, and revenue contribution, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and grow the program.
* Evaluate new publisher and partnership opportunities with the agency, considering brand fit and commercial potential.

*SEO Improvements & Implementation*

* Take ownership of identifying, prioritizing, and coordinating SEO improvements using BrightEdge and other relevant data sources.
* Identify keyword and content opportunities aligned with our product assortment, customer search behavior, and commercial priorities.
* Monitor organic traffic, keyword rankings, and organic revenue to evaluate progress and guide further improvements.

**What you bring**
You’re commercially minded and proactive, with a strong interest in performance marketing. You’re comfortable working with data, coordinating campaign delivery and turning insights into practical improvements. You take ownership, follow up when needed and enjoy working with different teams and partners to help marketing perform.
  
  
*We’re looking for someone with:*

* Three or more years of relevant experience in performance marketing, ideally in e-commerce or retail.
* A strong understanding of paid media channels and experience coordinating campaign execution and improving performance.
* Practical SEO experience, with the ability to turn insights into concrete website improvements.
* A commercial mindset and a clear understanding of revenue, acquisition costs and marketing efficiency.
* A proactive approach: you’re comfortable following up, challenging recommendations and taking ownership of delivery.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Fluency in both English and Dutch.

**What’s in it for you?**
You’ll help grow our online presence by improving the performance of our paid media and SEO activity. You’ll turn data and insights into practical actions, working with colleagues and external partners to help more people discover Marie-Stella-Maris.
  
  
*Alongside a competitive salary, we offer:*

* 25 vacation days based on a full-time contract, plus your birthday off
* Two additional days for social responsibility
* The opportunity to go on a workcation
* A pension contribution
* 20% discount on Marie-Stella-Maris products, with Refill available at the office and in our boutiques

job.title: Brand Manager @ Kramp (Utrecht, Utrecht, Netherlands)
job.description:
We are looking for a Brand Manager to strengthen the Kramp brand and bring it to life across our international markets.
  
  
You combine brand development, creative direction and people leadership. You translate customer needs and business priorities into a clear brand story, strong creative concepts and consistent execution across digital channels, campaigns, events, physical spaces and packaging.
  
  
Private label is an integral part of your role. Working closely with Category Managers, you develop clear brand propositions and translate these into distinctive identities, packaging and communication.
  
  
**Your role**

* Strengthen Kramp’s brand positioning and translate it into clear brand plans, creative concepts and communication, ensuring consistent brand expression across markets, channels and customer touchpoints.
* Own the corporate brand guidelines and visual and sonic identity, translating commercial priorities and customer insights into clear creative briefs and relevant communication.
* Develop private label brand positioning and identities in partnership with Category Managers, defining their relationship with the Kramp brand and translating commercial assortment strategy and Good / Better / Best principles into customer propositions, branding and packaging.
* Oversee packaging and labelling design for Kramp Group, ensuring consistency, production quality and compliance, while building a scalable approach to packaging development.
* Lead and develop the design function in Poland, with day-to-day support from the local design lead, setting clear objectives, creative standards and responsibilities.
* Take responsibility for recruitment, performance management, coaching and capability development, fostering collaboration, ownership and constructive feedback across the team.
* Manage creative agencies and specialist partners, align priorities with available resources, and improve creative processes through reusable assets, templates, automation and AI, while ensuring best practices and translating relevant developments in design and technology into practical improvements.

**Your Team**
You are part of the Brand & Digital leadership team and lead the design function in Poland, supported by a local design lead. You will lead a team of 7 design professionals based in Poland and the Netherlands.
  
  
**Who are you?**
You bring creative judgement, clear communication and the ability to turn strategy into action. You build strong relationships across countries and functions, while remaining comfortable setting direction and making choices.
  
  
You are organized, calm under pressure and focused on helping people deliver their best work.
  
  
**You have:**

* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience, with relevant experience in brand management, creative direction or brand design.
* Experience leading and developing a creative team, with a strong understanding of design principles, production processes and creative tools.
* A strong portfolio of brand projects across digital and physical channels, including experience with private label, packaging and labelling.
* Experience managing creative agencies, budgets and multiple projects.
* Fluent written and spoken English, and willingness to travel regularly to Poland and other Kramp markets.

**What do we offer?**
At Kramp, we believe meaningful rewards help people grow, perform, and thrive. Our reward package is designed to be fair, transparent, and competitive, giving you confidence and support to do your best work.
  
  
  
  
We offer an attractive salary of €6,597 - €8,063 gross per month, depending on your experience, qualifications and location. The compensation package also includes 8% holiday allowance.
  
  
**You Can Count On**

* 25 vacation days and 12 ADV days
* Flexible working policy in hours and location
* Travel- and working from home allowance
* Profit sharing bonus
* Great budget for training and courses
* Generous pension plan

We believe flexibility fuels performance, well-being, and long-term success. That’s why we offer a hybrid working arrangement that allows you to work from home two days a week and from our offices in Varsseveld or Utrecht on the other three. This gives you greater control over your work-life balance.
  
  
**Do you want to join us?**
In case you feel challenged by the above role description and requirements, we are interested in meeting you! Please use the application button and send your CV and cover letter.
  
  
If you do not fully meet all requirements for this role, and you think you would be a good match for us, please apply and convince us.
  
  
Do you have a question about this role? Please do not hesitate to contact Eirini Dragoumanou, Talent Acquisition Specialist, eirini.dragoumanou@kramp.com
  
  
**About Us**
Thanks to our ambitions we are active throughout Europe: a leading position in the agricultural market for parts. We heavily invest in E-Business and innovations. Our aim is to make it easy for our customers to run their business. Working at Kramp means working with over 3500 international colleagues. The people at Kramp are enthusiastic, professional and involved. We speak our customers’ language, understand their challenges and earn their trust to exceed their expectations. Our promise “It’s that easy” is embedded in our culture and DNA.
  
  
**Working at Kramp means:**
… you belong here! Being part of our open business community
  
  
… your work makes a difference! Have an impact on what matters
  
  
… you will develop and realize ! Learn and realize your potential

job.description:
**The ROLE**

Title

Customer Success Manager

Company

Measure Marketing (MMR), a Toronto-based GEO, AI search and SEO agency

Location

Remote: LATAM (Colombia preferred) or Europe

Hours

Overlap of at least 5 hours with North American business hours (ET)

Type

Full-time

Reports to

Head of Delivery (confirm)

Clients

B2B, law firms, signage, SaaS, and residential and commercial home improvement

**Search Changed the Map. You're the Client's GPS.**
----------------------------------------------------

Buyers don't just Google anymore. They ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews, and they often get an answer without ever clicking. That shift is why MMR exists: we help clients get found, cited and chosen across both classic and AI-powered search.

This role exists because great work only counts when the client can see it. You're the person who turns rankings, AI citations, traffic and leads into a clear story of progress. You catch risk before the client feels it, and you keep every account moving toward measurable outcomes.

Think of it as a marathon run at sprint pace. Relationships last for years, but you prove value every single month.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **1. Relationships That Fuel Retention**

* Be each client's trusted partner and main point of contact.
* Run check-ins , monthly and quarterly reviews that prove progress and set the next 90-day sprint.
* Handle escalations calmly and drive fast, accountable fixes.

### **2. Full-Funnel Performance: AI Search, SEO and PPC**

* Explain AI search shifts in plain English, including AI Overviews, zero-click results and citations in ChatGPT and Perplexity.
* Read paid search performance in Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, including spend, CPC, conversions and cost per lead, and flag when budget isn't turning into pipeline.
* Connect GEO, AEO, SEO and PPC to outcomes: visibility, qualified traffic, leads and cost per lead.
* Own the narrative while specialists handle execution.

### **3. Content and CRO Insight**

* Link content plans to client goals, and flag gaps for both search and AI engines.
* Raise the alarm when traffic or ad clicks grow but leads stay flat, then drive CRO fixes with the web team.

### **4. Data Storytelling, Human in the Loop**

* Turn data from GA4, Search Console, Google Ads, agency reporting tools and HubSpot into a monthly value story: what happened, why it matters and what's next.
* Use AI to draft reports, summarize calls and spot patterns. You verify the output, apply judgment and own every word the client sees.

### **5. The Retention System**

* Score every account based on leads and account health, customer sentiment, and run recovery plans for any account in Yellow or Red.
* Escalate any account that stays Red for more than 30 days.
* Pass expansion opportunities to the growth team when clients are winning.

### **6. Projects, ClickUp and Automation**

* Turn success plans into ClickUp projects with owners, milestones and deadlines, and keep HubSpot clean.
* Coordinate the SEO, PPC, content, web and dev teams while protecting scope and margin.
* Automate repetitive reporting and follow-ups with AI and workflow tools.

**What You Bring**
------------------

### **Must-Haves**

* 3+ years in customer success or account management at a digital marketing agency, SEO/SaaS company or similar B2B service business.
* A working understanding of SEO and PPC (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads), plus curiosity and early knowledge of AI search, GEO and AEO.
* Comfort with numbers: you can read GA4, Search Console and dashboard data and explain what changed and why.
* Proven ability to turn data into a clear, persuasive story for business owners and executives.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini for research, reporting and communication, plus the judgment to check their output.
* Experience running projects in ClickUp or a similar tool (Asana, Monday) and keeping a CRM like HubSpot clean.
* Confidence in tough conversations, including pushback, scope creep and at-risk renewals.
* Professional fluency in English, written and spoken, with North American clients.

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience with tracking and reporting tools, and reporting platforms.
* Basic CRO knowledge, such as landing page best practices, A/B testing and conversion tracking.
* Experience with workflow automation (Zapier, ClickUp automations).
* Background with B2B customers and an asset to know SaaS clients.
* Familiarity with net revenue retention, upsell motions and customer lifetime value.

**You are measured on customer results, relationships and expansions. Measured through customer NPS survey and retained revenue.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You're part relationship builder, part data storyteller and part project driver. You don't wait for clients to raise concerns. You see the dip in the dashboard first, figure out why, and walk in with a plan.

You use AI to move faster, but you never hand it the wheel. You're curious about where search is heading, and you can explain it to a business owner in two minutes without jargon.

Most of all, you own outcomes. Great relationships matter, but at MMR they're backed by measurable results.

**How to Apply**
----------------

Apply through our JazzHR careers page. You'll answer a few short questions as part of your application. They show us how you think, so give them five minutes.

This is a remote role open in LATAM (Colombia preferred) and Europe, with at least 5 hours of overlap with North American Eastern Time.
